title: What Is Ethanol Made Of? Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
A glass of water, a spoon of sugar, a bottle of hand sanitiser: each is built from a few elements. But how much of each one's mass belongs to each element? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 1, Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry) Diya reads a sanitiser label and we split ethanol's mass element by element.

On the molecule bench an ethanol molecule (C2H5OH) assembles bond by bond with shared electron pairs, then each part is weighed: 24.02 g of carbon, 6.048 g of hydrogen and 16.00 g of oxygen in 46.068 g, and a mass bar splits into 52.14%, 13.13% and 34.73%. A side by side of atom share vs mass share (hydrogen is 6 of 9 atoms but only 13.13% of the mass) leads to a pause and think check. Then the rule step by step on water (oxygen is 88.79% of its mass), the full ethanol worked example with a mass pie, the subscript exam trap, an original NEET pattern question on urea with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 10 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students.

In this video:
